Extra.Apparent Intent (L2): Create payments-domain projection tables (`payment_methods`, `payment_attempts`, `refunds`) in `payments` schema with FKs to `finance.payments`.
Extra.Actual Behavior (L0): Creates tables in `payments` schema but the FK references `finance.payments.id` — this assumes the `finance.payments` table already exists (it does, from an earlier migration). However, `domains/payments/models/payment_models.py` ALSO declares these same tables in `payments` schema. SQLAlchemy's metadata will see two `__tablename__` declarations for `payment_methods`, `payment_attempts`, `refunds` (one from `finance/models/payments.py` if it ever gets moved, and one from `payments/models/payment_models.py`). Currently only `payments/models/payment_models.py` declares them, but the migration docstring says "adds payments-domain projections" while the model file is the actual source of truth.
Extra.Divergence: HIGH: Two model files could declare the same table names if the finance→payments refactor completes.
Extra.Project Completion Impact: MEDIUM — Alembic autogenerate would detect conflicts.
